environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS CloudFront distribution with a response headers policy (ID: managed-policy-67f8-4d2c) that appends a Content-Security-Policy response header. The policy uses a custom response headers configuration with the CSP directive set via CloudFront Functions (viewer-response trigger, function name 'sec-headers-v3') which concatenates base policy from Parameter Store. The effective header value after function execution includes script-src with a nonce-based allowlist that rotates per-request using crypto.randomUUID(), combined with 'strict-dynamic'. The CloudFront distribution has origin failover disabled and the single origin points to the ALB. Note: the application's own response headers are NOT stripped — CloudFront's behavior is to append/override only headers specified in the response headers policy, meaning X-Content-Type-Options from the app is preserved but CSP is added by the edge function.

config.note: CloudFront response headers policy overrides any CSP set by origin when header name matches
